lines: {name}. You are the one filling in a Vellum for Halcyon Vess.
Isolde Kerrow. I direct the Stillwater Concord, which is a longer way of saying I sign things.
He writes to this office every week. Careful letters. Good numbers in them.
I read all of them. I have not answered one, and I would like to tell you why to your face rather than have yo
Seventy years ago the Hollow Sea turned over and took a town called Old Tidefall off the map in one night.
Two hundred and forty people. My brother was one of them. I was six.
Dr. Vess would like us to observe the Turning. Record it. Understand it.
I would like to stop it.
Not delay it. Not survive it. Stop it, permanently, and never have that conversation with anybody's family aga
You have walked the west arm. You have seen the streams dropping and the herds refusing the bridge.
Everyone tells you that is frightening. It is not. It is the sea being *held*.
That is us. That is working.
Go on to Brackwater. Take your Seals, they are a fine thing to have.
And when Vess writes to you about the Turning, ask him one question for me.
Ask him what he intends to say to the next Old Tidefall.
The Director's chair is empty. The soundings on the wall are not.
